title: Equivariant resolution evaluation has the normalized derived bar arrow
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on a small coherent profinite site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention], let $G$ be a profinite group, and let $N$ be an internal $A$-module with trivial $G$-action [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. Use ordinary derived categories and derived invariants [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus], with their canonical derived-functor unit [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. Write
$$R_N^n=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^{n+1}],N),\qquad n\geq0,$$
where the internal Hom is underived, $A[X]$ is the free internal module on the condensed set $X$, and $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$. Give $R_N^n$ the diagonal action $(g\cdot f)(g_0,\ldots,g_n)=f(g^{-1}g_0,\ldots,g^{-1}g_n)$, the differential $\sum_{i=0}^{n+1}(-1)^i f(g_0,\ldots,\widehat{g_i},\ldots,g_{n+1})$, and the constant-function augmentation $N[0]\to R_N^\bullet$. All complexes here vanish in negative degrees. Let $a:N[0]\to K^\bullet$ be an equivariant quasi-isomorphism and let $e:K^\bullet\to R_N^\bullet$ be an equivariant cochain map whose composite with $a$ is the constant-function augmentation.

Put $U_N^n=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^n],N)$ with the trivial-action inhomogeneous bar differential. Invariant homogeneous functions identify with $U_N^n$ by
$$f\longmapsto\bigl[(g_1,\ldots,g_n)\longmapsto f(1,g_1,g_1g_2,\ldots,g_1\cdots g_n)\bigr].$$
Let $\rho:(K^\bullet)^G\to U_N^\bullet$ be the resulting cochain map from $e$. Write $j:U_N^\bullet\to\mathscr B_A(G;N)$ for the underived-to-derived bar map, and $\epsilon:R\Gamma_G(N[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathscr B_A(G;N)$ for the normalized bar isomorphism of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-invariant-bar]. For $Q$ the localization at quasi-isomorphisms and $u_K:Q((K^\bullet)^G)\to R\Gamma_G(QK^\bullet)$ the canonical derived-invariants unit, the equality
$$j\circ Q(\rho)=\epsilon\circ(R\Gamma_G(Qa))^{-1}\circ u_K$$
holds in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_A)$. No acyclicity of $K^n$ or of $R_N^n$ is assumed. The bar uses compatible nonnegative injective resolutions as in the cited bar node.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-homogeneous-injective-total-target] to choose $s:N[0]\to I$ with $I$ K-injective and $Us$ injective, and form the nonnegative equivariantly injective total $T$ and constants $\delta:I\to T$. Write $F=\Gamma_G$; it is additive by [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus].

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-homogeneous-bar-coordinate-normalization] to this resolution. It supplies $\chi:F(T)\cong V$, $v=\chi F(\delta)$, $t:R_N\to T$ and $j_{\rm chain}$ with $j=Q(j_{\rm chain})$, $\chi F(te)=j_{\rm chain}\rho$, $t\operatorname{aug}=\delta s$, and $\epsilon=Q(v)u_I^{-1}RF(Qs)$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent expansion of equivariant resolution-to-bar normalization

proof.text: The map $a$ is degreewise monic. In degree zero, since $K^{-1}=0$, its induced isomorphism $N=H^0(N[0])\to H^0(K)=\ker d_K^0$ shows that $a^0$ is a monomorphism; in other degrees the source is zero. Apply the cited lifting lemma to the monomorphic quasi-isomorphism $a:N[0]\to K$, the bounded-below injective complex $I$, and $s:N[0]\to I$. It gives an equivariant cochain map $b:K\to I$ with $ba=s$.

Both $te$ and $\delta b$ restrict along $a$ to $\delta s$: for $te$ use $ea=\operatorname{aug}$ and step 2, and for $\delta b$ use $ba=s$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-lift-to-injective-unique-up-to-homotopy] to the quasi-isomorphism $a$ and the bounded-below injective target $T$ of step 1 to obtain $te\simeq\delta b$. Additivity of $F$ preserves $te-\delta b=dH+Hd$; localization kills that homotopy. Thus $Q(\chi)QF(te)=Q(v)QF(b)$, and step 2 gives $jQ(\rho)=Q(v)QF(b)$.

Naturality of the unit gives $QF(b)=u_I^{-1}RF(Qb)u_K$. From $ba=s$ and invertibility of $Qa$, $RF(Qb)=RF(Qs)(RF(Qa))^{-1}$. Hence $jQ(\rho)=Q(v)u_I^{-1}RF(Qs)(RF(Qa))^{-1}u_K=\epsilon(RF(Qa))^{-1}u_K$. Only the auxiliary complexes $I,T$ had injective terms; no acyclicity of $K^n$ or $R_N^n$ was used.

lean.statement: theorem equivariant_resolution_bar_normalization (M : Model A G) (N : Modules A) (H : HomogeneousBar (G := G) N) (K : CochainComplex (Equivariant A G) ℕ) (a : (CochainComplex.single₀ (Equivariant A G)).obj ((trivial (P := G)).obj N) ⟶ K) [QuasiIso a] (e : K ⟶ H.complex) (hea : a ≫ e = H.augmentation) (rho : (M.invariants.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj K ⟶ (cochains M.bar).obj ((trivial (P := G)).obj N)) (hrho : ResolutionEvaluation M H e rho) (I : InjectiveResolution ((trivial (P := G)).obj N)) (j : (cochains M.bar).obj ((trivial (P := G)).obj N) ⟶ (totalCochains M.bar).obj I.cocomplex) (hj : UnderivedBarComponents M N I j) : DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap rho ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap j ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) = invariantUnit M.invariants K ≫ (M.invariants.functor.rightDerivedFunctor.mapIso (localizedAugmentation a)).inv ≫ (M.computation.iso I).hom
